_note: Which CI jobs and steps carry each canonical gate, per SLICE-002 section 2 and D-126. A gate that resolves to no job in a run's jobs payload reads `unresolved`, which makes the record not measurable, so a renamed or deleted job announces itself in the next record instead of reading as a pass.

validate-core._note: The validate step inside every suite job, not a job of its own.
validate-core.step: Validate the core before anything writes to the tree
